_comment: Grid capacity limits (kW) per TOU band for HEMS demand management.
Basis: LECO/CEB standard domestic single-phase 30A connection @ 230V = ~6.9 kW physical limit.
These limits are HEMS demand management targets (always below the physical connection limit).
Appliance total max simultaneous load = 7.1 kW (WM:0.6 + Heater:2.0 + AC:1.2 + VC:2.2 + Vac:1.1).
Off-Peak : generous - grid is lightly loaded, load-shifting is encouraged here.
Day      : moderate - typical daytime household activity, partial demand management.
Peak     : strict  - grid most stressed (18:00-22:00), only ~2 light appliances allowed.
